note: Local followup keys only; no successor TASK created or assigned; global registry not edited. All repairs require a separate assignment.

items.problem: Checking the same successful request gives no distinct visible acknowledgement; always-visible technical control is confusing.
items.action: Agree Russian status text and placement/conditional recovery affordance; provide progress and observable completion feedback without resending.
items.closure_evidence: Visible response for unchanged, pending, absent and failed status checks; keyboard and mouse; no duplicate execution; separate review.

items.problem: RUNNING user without assistant is labelled interrupted while request is active.
items.action: Distinguish active execution from genuinely unknown/lost-owner outcome using authoritative facts.
items.closure_evidence: Active, succeeded, cancelled and unknown states display accurately; source/HTTP/UI comparison and independent review.

items.problem: User reports unknown outcome after cancellation and message disappearance after F5; not reproduced and RAW deletion not established.
items.action: Prioritize one controlled offline cancel/reload with the same Workspace/Chat/Turn identity, RAW hashes/existence, history/API and exclusions/page state before and after; no cleanup or provider calls.
items.closure_evidence: Reproduction or bounded negative result with retained artifacts; identify storage versus projection/selection cause; independent verification before asserting data preservation/fix.

items.problem: Retained RAW and next-request context are different; current Stage5 selects one verified successful pair and omits unanswered historical user messages.
items.action: Document/agree user-visible semantics. Do not treat omission from context as UI disappearance or silently include cancelled/unknown content.
items.closure_evidence: Agreed policy and bounded successful/cancelled/unknown/size-limit examples showing RAW/history/context separately.

items.problem: Status check has revision guard, history loads only epoch guard; stale same-chat history response might overwrite newer history. No request trace proves this occurred.
items.action: Use deterministic reversed response order in a separately authorized test; cover check during accepting/executing and send completion.
items.closure_evidence: Exact request order and state/history assertions; repair only if reproduced or otherwise justified; no assumption that this caused F3.

items.problem: Local Russian label/tooltip and guidance are present; browser run predates the wording change.
items.action: After authorized TEST restart check the long Russian label, tooltip and error guidance at normal/narrow viewport and keyboard focus.
items.closure_evidence: Screenshot and accessibility confirmation at the exact local source revision; no publication or rollback implied.
